thought.text: Only the XPlanWMS references the remote MapServer URL. Now let me implement the reverse-proxy architecture: move Tomcats to internal ports, front them + MapServer CGI with Apache on 8080.

reasoning_content:
Good — only XPlanWMS depends on the remote MapServer. The other workspaces don't have self-referencing URLs (only the `.gfi` HTML file has localhost:8080 for display purposes, which is fine).

Now let me implement the reverse proxy architecture. I'll:
1. Stop the Tomcats
2. Move all three Tomcats to internal ports (18080/18081/18082)
3. Configure Apache on 8080 with:
   - MapServer CGI at `/xplan-mapserver`
   - WMS/WFS/WFS-Syn/ValidatorWMS/InspirePLU → tomcat-dienste:18080
   - Manager-Web/Validator-Web/ROOT → tomcat-anwendung:18081
   - Manager-API/Validator-API/Dokumente-API → tomcat-api:18082

Let me update the setenv files and server.xml ports, then write the Apache config.

action.command:
unset CATALINA_PID
# Stop all tomcats
for t in dienste anwendung api; do /opt/tomcat-$t/bin/shutdown.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; done
sleep 8
for p in $(ps aux | grep "[c]atalina.base" | awk '{print $2}'); do kill "$p" 2>/dev/null; done
sleep 5
ps aux | grep -c "[c]atalina.base"
# Change ports: dienste 18080/18005, anwendung 18081/18006, api 18082/18007
sed -i 's/port="8080"/port="18080"/; s/port="8005"/port="18005"/' /opt/tomcat-dienste/conf/server.xml
sed -i 's/port="8081"/port="18081"/; s/port="8006"/port="18006"/' /opt/tomcat-anwendung/conf/server.xml
sed -i 's/port="8082"/port="18082"/; s/port="8007"/port="18007"/' /opt/tomcat-api/conf/server.xml
grep -oE 'port="18[0-9]+"' /opt/tomcat-dienste/conf/server.xml | head -3; grep -oE 'port="18[0-9]+"' /opt/tomcat-anwendung/conf/server.xml | head -3; grep -oE 'port="18[0-9]+"' /opt/tomcat-api/conf/server.xml | head -3
